description: This file defines the 'PreconditionHeader' interface, which specifies methods for headers that check preconditions according to RFC 7232. It is used as a contract for implementing headers that validate certain conditions for objects of a generic type T.

classes.name: PreconditionHeader
classes.description: Interface for all precondition headers according to RFC 7232, parameterized with type T. Declares methods for retrieving header key and value, and for evaluating conditions on objects of type T.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the header.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Checks if the header's condition is met for the provided object of type T.
